name: topical-guardrailing-nemo-benchmarking
description: Benchmark for evaluating model topical guardrailing: whether models correctly refuse, safely handle, or inappropriately respond to prompts on sensitive or disallowed topics. It measures a model's ability to follow topical safety constraints and produce safe outputs across a range of scenarios. Useful for testing moderation/guardrail systems and topical refusal behaviors.
reputation: An experimental/engineering benchmark used for guardrail evaluation with limited public adoption outside specific safety evaluation workflows.
